about.name: Coach James Dickens
about.title: OL
about.age_groups: College, Varsity, JV/Frosh, Middle School, Youth
about.bio:
Coach James Dickens brings 3 years of experience running the Wing-T system in the area. With a sharp offensive mind and a track record of developing athletes who perform at the next level, Coach Dickens is known for making practice reps count. Works with athletes at the College, Varsity, JV/Frosh, Middle School, Youth level.

From route running to pre-snap reads to protection schemes — Coach Dickens delivers the kind of coaching that shows up in the box score.

services.title: Wing-T System Coaching
services.description: Installation and development of the Wing-T offense — from core concepts to advanced adjustments that put defenses in conflict.

services.title: Skill Position Development
services.description: Individual coaching for QBs, WRs, RBs, and TEs focused on technique, route running, footwork, and pre-snap reads.

services.title: Offensive Playbook & Film Study
services.description: Playbook design tailored to your personnel, plus film sessions that sharpen in-game decision making for players and staff.
